title: Frank black - Supposed to Be
htmlContent:
Talented artist Frank black sets the party’s mood with his new single “Supposed to Be.” The track has a melancholy and moody feel, but the emcee comes through with an energetic flow and an easygoing demeanor.

“Supposed to Be” is popular because of Frank’s natural skill and flair for songwriting. His fans worldwide have taken to the song, so his message must have gotten through. It was his goal to assemble something that would stimulate a positive response from the audience.

Frank black “Supposed to Be” is now available on all streaming outlets.
